homepage.meta.description.message: A TypeScript HTTP request builder that organizes the native Fetch API into readable chains

homepage.hero.description.message: dench-fetch keeps the flexibility of the native Fetch API while organizing repetitive request options into short, type-safe chains.

homepage.features.description.message: dench-fetch is a TypeScript request builder built on the native Fetch API. Compose requests with short, readable chains instead of complex configuration objects, then execute them explicitly when needed.

homepage.features.readable.description.message: Write the request flow naturally from top to bottom, from the HTTP method through authentication, timeout, and response format.

homepage.features.runner.description.message: Building a request does not send it. The actual fetch runs only when you select the response format.

homepage.features.body.title.message: Choose body formats without the boilerplate

homepage.features.body.description.message: Set JSON, FormData, Blob, URL-encoded data, or a raw body with a method designed for that format.

homepage.features.reusable.description.message: Copy a builder with authentication and timeout settings, then change only the API path to reduce repetition.
